headline: Haiti agrees to build three prisons with Salvadoran companies
summary: Haiti's government announced an agreement with El Salvador to build three new prisons in Haiti. A Salvadoran prison infrastructure company and a local firm will take part.
why: Government infrastructure contracts involving foreign firms can shape construction activity and public spending in fragile economies.
original_headline: Haití acuerda construir tres cárceles con empresas salvadoreñas
